mapper.select: SELECT c.*, (SELECT content FROM messages m WHERE m.conversation_id=c.id AND m.message_type<>'system_hint' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS preview, (SELECT count(*) FROM messages unread WHERE unread.conversation_id=c.id AND unread.direction='inbound' AND unread.message_type<>'system_hint' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM message_reads viewed WHERE viewed.message_id=unread.id AND viewed.reader_username=#{reader})) AS unread_count FROM conversations c WHERE shop_id=#{shopId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC

SELECT count(*) FROM messages m WHERE m.conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND m.direction='inbound' AND m.message_type<>'system_hint' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM message_reads r WHERE r.message_id=m.id AND r.reader_username=#{reader})
SELECT r.message_id FROM message_reads r JOIN messages m ON m.id=r.message_id WHERE m.conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND r.reader_username=#{reader}
SELECT id FROM messages WHERE id=#{messageId} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND direction='inbound' AND message_type<>'system_hint'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message_reads(message_id,reader_username,read_at) SELECT #{messageId},#{reader},#{time} WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM message_reads WHERE message_id=#{messageId} AND reader_username=#{reader})
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.direction, m.message_type, m.content, m.state, m.occurred_at, m.received_at, m.media_json,m.platform_message_id,CASE WHEN THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS context_only FROM messages m WHERE m.conversation_id=#{conversationId} ORDER BY m.created_at,m.id
SELECT d.* FROM drafts d JOIN messages m ON m.id=d.message_id WHERE m.conversation_id=#{conversationId} ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC
SELECT id,draft_id,manual_reply_id,state,attempt,revision,error_code,updated_at,receipt,product_cards FROM send_command_context WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC

SELECT r.id,r.message_id,r.conversation_revision,r.state,r.created_at,r.result FROM agent_runs r JOIN messages m ON m.id=r.message_id WHERE m.conversation_id=#{conversationId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
SELECT id FROM send_command_context WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND state IN ('approved','sending')
mapper.update: UPDATE conversations SET state='transferred',revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{conversationId}
UPDATE conversations SET state='open',revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{conversationId}
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM send_command_context WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND state='send_unknown'
mapper.update: UPDATE drafts SET state='transferred' WHERE message_id IN (SELECT id FROM messages WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId}) AND state IN ('waiting_human','outdated','send_failed')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM audit_events WHERE shop_id=#{shopId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100
